notes.title: Update Notes 27th Jan, 2021
notes.content:
Heya, there's been an update to fix some small issues I never got around to releasing.
[list]
[*] Fixed a display issue with the color blind hint of the final boss.
[*] Slightly reduced the difficulty of 4-2 (UHC) and added checkpoints to 5-1 (UHC).
[*] Adjusted some credits texts.
[/list]
Have a nice day.
- DPlay
